name: apply_token_bitmask
description: Grammar-mask application with signature apply_token_bitmask(logits, bitmask). logits has shape [B, V]; bitmask is int32 [B, ceil(V/32)] with bit j of word w selecting vocabulary entry 32*w+j. Return a newly allocated tensor of logits.dtype and shape [B, V] where entries with a set bit retain the corresponding logit and entries with a clear bit become -inf. The implementation is an exact bit test and preserves NaN/Inf logits for kept entries. The suite exercises float32 logits with V from 100 to 152064; inputs are not modified.
